items.stem: A car travels 150 miles in 3 hours at a constant speed. At this speed, how many miles will the car travel in 5 hours?
items.explanation: Скорость 150/3 = 50 миль в час, за 5 часов — 250 миль (B). 450 — 150 · 3; 300 — 150 · 2; 200 — прибавили 50 к 150.

items.stem: A recipe uses 2 cups of sugar for every 3 cups of flour. How many cups of sugar are needed for 12 cups of flour?
items.explanation: Муки в 4 раза больше (12/3 = 4), сахара тоже: 2 · 4 = 8 чашек.

items.stem: One inch is equal to 2.54 centimeters. How many centimeters are in 10 inches?
items.explanation: 10 · 2.54 = 25.4 см (C). 3.94 — разделили 10 на 2.54; 12.54 — сложили; 254 — сдвинули запятую.

items.stem: A class has 12 boys and 18 girls. What is the ratio of boys to girls in the class?
items.explanation: 12 : 18 = 2 : 3 (делим на 6) (A). 3:2 — девочки к мальчикам; 2:5 и 12:30 — мальчики ко всему классу.

items.stem: A printer prints 45 pages per minute. How many minutes will it take the printer to print 360 pages?
items.explanation: Время = объём работы / скорость: 360/45 = 8 минут.

items.stem: A bag of 4 pounds of apples costs $3.60. What is the price per pound?
items.explanation: 3.60/4 = 0.90 доллара за фунт (B). 1.11 — 4/3.60, фунты на доллар; 14.40 — умножили; 0.80 — ошибка деления.

items.stem: On a map, 1 centimeter represents 5 kilometers. Two towns are 7 centimeters apart on the map. What is the actual distance between the towns, in kilometers?
items.explanation: 7 · 5 = 35 км (C). 12 — сложили; 1.4 — разделили 7 на 5; 70 — лишний ноль.

items.stem: A worker earns $18 per hour. How many hours must the worker work to earn $252?
items.explanation: Часы = заработок / ставка: 252/18 = 14 часов.

items.stem: If 5 notebooks cost $8, how much do 15 notebooks cost at the same price per notebook?
items.explanation: Тетрадей в 3 раза больше, цена тоже: 8 · 3 = 24 (B). 120 — 8 · 15; 40 — 8 · 5; 16 — удвоили.

items.stem: A pump moves 12 liters of water per minute. How many liters does it move in 1 hour?
items.explanation: В часе 60 минут: 12 · 60 = 720 литров (D). 72 и 120 — неверное число минут; 600 — 10 · 60.

items.stem: The ratio of cats to dogs at a shelter is 4 to 5. If there are 20 cats at the shelter, how many dogs are there?
items.explanation: 20 кошек — это 4 части по 5, собак 5 частей: 25.

items.stem: A runner covers 400 meters in 80 seconds. What is her average speed, in meters per second?
items.explanation: 400/80 = 5 м/с (B). 0.2 — секунды на метр; 320 и 480 — вычли и сложили.

items.stem: One kilogram is approximately 2.2 pounds. A package weighs 11 pounds. Approximately how many kilograms does the package weigh?
items.explanation: Килограмм тяжелее фунта, поэтому делим: 11/2.2 = 5 кг (A). 24.2 — умножили; 8.8 и 13.2 — вычли и прибавили 2.2.

items.stem: A train travels at a constant speed of 90 kilometers per hour. How many kilometers does it travel in 2.5 hours?
items.explanation: Расстояние = скорость · время: 90 · 2.5 = 225 км.

items.stem: In a drink mixture, the ratio of water to juice concentrate is 5 to 1. How many cups of water are needed for 3 cups of concentrate?
items.explanation: На каждую чашку концентрата 5 чашек воды: 15 (C). 18 — общий объём смеси; 8 — 5 + 3.

items.stem: A car uses 6 gallons of gas to travel 168 miles. At this rate, how many gallons of gas will the car use to travel 280 miles?
items.explanation: 168/6 = 28 миль на галлон; 280/28 = 10 галлонов (B). 14 — 280/20; 8 и 12 — грубое округление пропорции.

items.stem: A garden plot with an area of 12 square meters needs 3.6 kilograms of fertilizer. At this rate, how many kilograms of fertilizer are needed for a plot with an area of 45 square meters?
A speed of 72 kilometers per hour is equivalent to how many meters per second?
items.explanation: 72 км/ч = 72 000 м за 3600 с = 20 м/с (C). 259.2 — умножили на 3.6 вместо деления; 12 и 7.2 — неверные множители.

items.stem: The ratio of red marbles to blue marbles in a bag is 3 to 7. There are 60 marbles in the bag, and all are red or blue. How many red marbles are in the bag?
items.explanation: Всего 3 + 7 = 10 частей по 6 шариков: красных 3 · 6 = 18 (B). 42 — синие; 21 — это 3 · 7, произведение чисел отношения; 9 — 3 · 3.

items.stem: Machine A makes 40 parts per hour and machine B makes 60 parts per hour. Working together at these rates, how many hours will it take the two machines to make 450 parts?
items.explanation: Вместе 100 деталей в час, 450/100 = 4.5 часа.

items.stem: Aluminum has a density of 2.7 grams per cubic centimeter. What is the mass, in grams, of 50 cubic centimeters of aluminum?
items.explanation: Масса = плотность · объём = 2.7 · 50 = 135 г (C). 18.5 — 50/2.7; 52.7 — сложили; 1350 — лишний ноль.

items.stem: Three workers can paint a fence in 8 hours. Working at the same rate, how many hours would it take 4 workers to paint the same fence?
items.explanation: Работа — 3 · 8 = 24 человеко-часа; 24/4 = 6 часов (B). 10.67 — прямая пропорция 8 · 4/3, но больше рабочих — меньше времени; 32 — 8 · 4.

items.stem: A tablet screen is 1,920 pixels wide and 1,200 pixels tall. What is the ratio of the width to the height, written as a decimal?
Sound travels about 343 meters per second in air. About how many kilometers does sound travel in 1 minute?
items.explanation: 343 · 60 = 20 580 м = 20.58 км (C). 0.343 — за секунду; 5.7 — 343/60; 205.8 — неверный перевод в километры.

items.stem: A store sells rice in a 2-kilogram bag for $5.40 and in a 5-kilogram bag for $12.50. How much less per kilogram does the rice in the 5-kilogram bag cost?
items.explanation: Маленькая упаковка: 5.40/2 = 2.70 доллара за кг, большая: 12.50/5 = 2.50. Разница 0.20 (A). 2.50 — цена кг большой упаковки; 7.10 — разность цен упаковок; 0.50 — ошибка.

items.stem: If x/y = 3/8 and y = 56, what is the value of x?
items.explanation: Из x/y = 3/8 следует x = (3/8) · y. Подставляем y = 56: x = 3 · 56 / 8 = 3 · 7 = 21.

items.stem: A cyclist rides 18 kilometers in 45 minutes at a constant speed. What is the cyclist's speed, in kilometers per hour?
There are 12 inches in 1 foot and 3 feet in 1 yard. How many inches are in 2.5 yards?
items.explanation: 2.5 ярда = 7.5 фута = 90 дюймов (C). 30 — забыли футы; 45 — умножили на 18; 108 — взяли 3 ярда.

items.stem: A faucet leaks 4 milliliters of water every 15 seconds. At this rate, how many liters of water does the faucet leak in 24 hours? (1 liter = 1,000 milliliters)
items.explanation: В сутках 86 400 секунд — это 5760 интервалов по 15 с. 5760 · 4 = 23 040 мл = 23.04 л.

items.stem: On a scale drawing, 2 inches represent 15 feet. A wall is 25 feet long. How long, in inches, is the wall on the drawing?
items.explanation: 1 фут = 2/15 дюйма, 25 футов = 50/15 = 10/3 ≈ 3.33 дюйма (B). 37.5 — перевернули пропорцию; 5 и 3 — округления.

items.stem: Pipe A can fill a tank in 6 hours, and pipe B can fill the same tank in 3 hours. If both pipes are used together, how many hours will it take to fill the tank?
items.explanation: Скорости 1/6 и 1/3 бака в час, вместе 1/2 бака в час — 2 часа (A). 4.5 — среднее время; 9 — сложили времена; 3 — время одной трубы B.

items.stem: A car gets 32 miles per gallon, and gas costs $3.60 per gallon. What is the cost, in dollars, of the gas needed to drive 400 miles?
The ratio of a to b is 2 to 3, and the ratio of b to c is 4 to 5. What is the ratio of a to c?
items.explanation: Приведём b к общему числу 12: a : b = 8 : 12, b : c = 12 : 15, значит a : c = 8 : 15 (A). 2:5 — перемножили первые и сложили вторые числа; 6:20 и 10:12 — неверно выровняли b.

items.stem: One mile is approximately 1.61 kilometers. A race is 42.2 kilometers long. To the nearest tenth of a mile, how long is the race?
items.explanation: Миля длиннее километра, поэтому делим: 42.2/1.61 ≈ 26.2 мили (A). 67.9 и 68.0 — умножили; 40.6 — вычли 1.61.

items.stem: Two cities are 420 kilometers apart. Two trains leave the cities at the same time and travel toward each other at constant speeds of 80 kilometers per hour and 60 kilometers per hour. After how many hours will the trains meet?
items.explanation: Расстояние сокращается на 80 + 60 = 140 км в час; 420/140 = 3 часа.

items.stem: A recipe that makes 4 servings uses 300 grams of flour. Lena wants to make 10 servings but has only 600 grams of flour. How many more grams of flour does she need?
items.explanation: Для 10 порций нужно 75 · 10 = 750 г; не хватает 150 г (A). 750 — всё количество; 300 и 450 — ошибки в масштабировании.

items.stem: The exchange rates are 1 euro = 1.08 US dollars and 1 US dollar = 470 Kazakhstani tenge. How many tenge are equal to 50 euros?
items.explanation: 50 евро = 54 доллара = 54 · 470 = 25 380 тенге (C). 23 500 — забыли курс евро; 21 759 — разделили на 1.08; 50 760 — удвоили.

items.stem: A rectangular field is 120 meters long and 80 meters wide. On a map with a scale of 1:2,000, what is the area of the field on the map, in square centimeters?
items.explanation: 120 м = 12 000 см, на карте 6 см; 80 м → 4 см. Площадь 6 · 4 = 24 см². Масштаб площади — квадрат линейного масштаба.

items.stem: A hiker walks up a trail at an average speed of 3 kilometers per hour and returns down the same trail at an average speed of 6 kilometers per hour. What is the hiker's average speed for the entire round trip, in kilometers per hour?
items.explanation: Пусть тропа 6 км: вверх 2 часа, вниз 1 час, всего 12 км за 3 часа — 4 км/ч (A). 4.5 — простое среднее скоростей, но дольше идут медленно; 9 — сумма скоростей.

items.stem: A medicine is prescribed at 15 milligrams per kilogram of body weight per day, divided into 3 equal doses. How many milligrams are in each dose for a child who weighs 22 kilograms?
items.explanation: В сутки 15 · 22 = 330 мг, на один приём 330/3 = 110 мг (B). 330 — суточная доза; 990 — умножили на 3; 66 — 22 · 3.

items.stem: Eight identical machines make 960 parts in 6 hours. At the same rate, how many parts will 5 of these machines make in 9 hours?
items.explanation: Одна машина за час: 960/(8 · 6) = 20 деталей. 5 машин за 9 часов: 20 · 45 = 900.

items.stem: A full tank holds 2,500 liters of water. Water drains from the tank at 40 liters per minute while it is being refilled at 15 liters per minute. How many hours will it take the full tank to empty?
items.explanation: Чистый расход 40 − 15 = 25 л/мин, 2500/25 = 100 минут = 5/3 часа (B). 100 — ответ в минутах; 1.25 — 2500/(40 · 50); 2.5 — сложили скорости.

items.stem: An athlete's heart pumps 70 milliliters of blood per beat at a rate of 60 beats per minute. How many liters of blood does the heart pump in 1 hour?
items.explanation: 70 · 60 = 4200 мл в минуту, за час 252 000 мл = 252 л (C). 4.2 — литры в минуту; 4200 — миллилитры в минуту; 25.2 — ошибка в переводе.

items.stem: The ratio of x to y is 5 to 2, and x − y = 21. What is the value of x + y?
items.explanation: x = 5k, y = 2k, разность 3k = 21, k = 7. x + y = 7k = 49.

items.stem: Car A travels 300 kilometers using 24 liters of fuel. Car B travels 360 kilometers using 30 liters of fuel. Which of the following statements is true?
choices: Car A travels 0.5 kilometer more per liter of fuel than car B.
Car B travels 0.5 kilometer more per liter of fuel than car A.
The two cars travel the same distance per liter of fuel.
Car A uses 6 more liters of fuel per 100 kilometers than car B.
items.explanation: A: 300/24 = 12.5 км/л, B: 360/30 = 12 км/л — у A на 0.5 больше (A). B переворачивает сравнение; C неверно; D — 6 литров это разница в общем расходе, а не на 100 км (на 100 км: 8 и 8.33).
